def test_paginate_query_overshoot_and_no_duplicates():
    from server.pagination import paginate_query

    class FakeQuery:
        def __init__(self, items):
            self._items = list(items)
            self._limit = None
            self._offset = 0
        def count(self):
            return len(self._items)
        def limit(self, n):
            self._limit = n
            return self
        def offset(self, n):
            self._offset = n
            return self
        def all(self):
            start = self._offset
            end = None if self._limit is None else self._offset + self._limit
            return self._items[start:end]

    items = list(range(160))
    q = FakeQuery(items)

    # page before last
    page1, total = paginate_query(q, limit=50, offset=100)
    assert total == 160
    assert page1 == list(range(100, 150))

    # last partial page (no overlap with previous)
    q = FakeQuery(items)
    page2, total = paginate_query(q, limit=50, offset=150)
    assert page2 == list(range(150, 160))

    # offset exactly at total -> empty
    q = FakeQuery(items)
    page_empty, total = paginate_query(q, limit=50, offset=160)
    assert page_empty == []

    # offset past total -> empty
    q = FakeQuery(items)
    page_past, total = paginate_query(q, limit=50, offset=170)
    assert page_past == []
```
